# anomaly_integration (Resource)

Manages a nxs-anomaly integration (alert ingestion endpoint).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anomaly_integration" "prometheus" {
  name     = "Prometheus Alertmanager"
  type     = "alertmanager"
  group_by = ["alertname", "cluster", "namespace"]

  webhook_secret = var.webhook_secret

  routes = [
    {
      name                = "critical-route"
      escalation_chain_id = anomaly_escalation_chain.critical.id
      conditions = [
        {
          field = "severity"
          op    = "eq"
          value = "critical"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      name                = "default-route"
      escalation_chain_id = anomaly_escalation_chain.critical.id
      conditions          = []
    }
  ]
}

variable "webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  default   = ""
}

output "webhook_url" {
  value = "http://localhost:8080/integrations/v1/alertmanager/${anomaly_integration.prometheus.key}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `group_by` (List of String) Alert fields used for grouping alerts into alert groups.
- `heartbeat` (Attributes) Silence detection: raise a SourceSilent alert when this source stops sending. Opt-in — with interval_seconds unset (0) the integration is never reported for being quiet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--heartbeat))
- `kafka_topic` (String) Kafka topic used for integration outbox events.
- `legacy_pool` (Attributes) Legacy duty pool used by legacy ingestion payloads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--legacy_pool))
- `notification_policy` (Attributes) Controls notification batching and escalation behaviour. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_policy))
- `pipeline` (String) Ingest pipeline as a JSON array of stages, each one action (extract, set, rename, remove, gsub, truncate, drop) with an optional "if". Runs AFTER route selection, so it shapes deduplication, the stored alert and the notification text but never moves which escalation chain pages — the route follows from the alert as the source sent it. Pass it with jsonencode(); the API rejects a pipeline that does not compile, so a bad rule fails the apply rather than the next incident. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md in nxs-anomaly.
- `routes` (Attributes List) Routing rules. Exactly one route must have is_default=true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `source_type` (String)
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team that owns this integration.
- `templates` (Map of String) Go template strings keyed by channel name (telegram, email, webhook, sms, phone; "default" covers the rest) used for notification rendering. Variables: title, severity, reason, group_id, status, user_name, user_username, labels (all of the alert's labels as "k=v, k=v"), and label_<name> for each one — so {{ .label_pod }} and {{ .label_namespace }} name the pod and namespace. Characters a template identifier cannot hold become underscores, so kubernetes.io/name is label_kubernetes_io_name. E.g. "*[{{ .severity }}]* {{ .title }} ({{ .label_namespace }})"; CamelCase aliases such as {{ .Severity }} also resolve. Removing the attribute keeps the value already stored; set templates = {} to clear them and fall back to the built-in format.
- `type` (String) Integration type: webhook, alertmanager, pagerduty, victorops, grafana-alerting.
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC secret for webhook signature validation (X-Hub-Signature-256).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String) Auto-generated integration key used in the webhook URL.
- `provisioned_by` (String) Set to "terraform" for objects this provider created. The API then refuses edits from anyone else and the web UI disables its own controls, so an out-of-band change cannot be silently undone by the next apply.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--heartbeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `heartbeat`

Optional:

- `grace_seconds` (Number) Extra slack for a late tick. Defaults to a third of interval_seconds when the check is enabled and this is left at 0.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) How long the source may stay silent before that is news. Values below 60 are raised to 60 by the API; 0 disables the check.

Optional:

- `description` (String)
- `duty_user_id` (String)
- `emails` (List of String)
- `emergency_user_id` (String)
- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `batch_timeout_seconds` (Number)
- `channels` (List of String) Notification channels: webhook, telegram, email, sms, phone.
- `emergency_user_id` (String)

- `epic_threshold_seconds` (Number)
- `epic_user_id` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `escalation_chain_id` (String) ID of the escalation chain to trigger.
- `id` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean) Exactly one route per integration must be the default.
- `labels` (Map of String) Label key=value pairs to match (match_type=labels).
- `match_type` (String) Match strategy: all (catch-all), labels (match label map), regex (match payload regex).
- `pattern` (String) Regex pattern applied to the JSON payload (match_type=regex).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace object-id with the existing object identifier.
terraform import anomaly_integration.prometheus object-id
```
